fields.value: No unrestricted at-will termination right. Conditional no-fault rights: either party may terminate on 30 days if federal privacy/User Data laws impede or prohibit performance; Excite@Home may terminate on 30 days after certain e-centives acquisitions by an Excite@Home Named Competitor; Excite@Home may terminate on 90 days if e-centives cannot or will not deliver requested modifications or the parties disagree on direction/integration.

quotes.text:
Either party may terminate the Agreement without penalty upon thirty (30)
days' written notice if regulations or applicable laws applied at the US
federal level regarding privacy or User Data purchase and/or usage impede
or prohibit said party from performing its services as contemplated by this
Agreement or thereafter.

In the event that a majority of Application Provider's assets are merged,
acquired or sold to an Excite@Home Named Competitor, or to an entity
controlling or controlled by an Excite@Home Named Competitor, then
Excite@Home may terminate this Agreement by providing thirty (30) days
written notice.

In the event that
Application Provider is unable and/or unwilling to deliver such additions,
or in the event that the parties disagree on the direction of the
Co-Branded Application or its integration, Excite@Home may terminate the
Agreement with no penalty by providing ninety (90) days written notice.

fields.value: Either party may terminate for uncured breach after 30 days' notice. Excite@Home may also terminate on 30 days if e-centives fails content/launch guidelines, and may terminate if the Co-Branded Application is not comparable after a 28-day cure period.

quotes.text:
Either party may terminate if the other party breaches the
Agreement and the breach remains uncured for thirty (30) days
following receipt of written notice of intention to terminate
from the other party.

Excite@Home may terminate the Agreement with thirty (30) days
written notice if Application Provider does not meet the content
and launch guidelines described in EXHIBIT B.

If Excite@Home determines that the Co-Branded Application is not at
least comparable to other sources of Application Content generally
available on the Internet in terms of at least two of the four factors
in Section 16.a.iii.1, Excite@Home may notify Application Provider in
writing of said deficiency, which shall initiate a 28-day "Cure
Period." If at the end of the Cure Period Excite@Home, in its
reasonable judgment, determines that the deficiency still exists, then
Excite@Home may terminate the Agreement without further delay.

fields.value: Direct damages only; each party's liability for damages is limited to the amounts actually paid by the other party, except specified indemnity claims under Sections 19(a)(iii)(2), 19(a)(iii)(3), 19(b)(iii)(2), and 19(b)(iii)(3).

quotes.text:
Except as provided by Sections 19(a)(iii)(2), (a)(iii)(3), (b)(iii)(2) and
(b)(iii)(3):
a) Neither party will have liability for any damages other than direct
damages. In no event will either party be liable to the other for any
special, incidental or consequential damages, whether based on breach
of contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise, whether or not
that party has been advised of the possibility of such damage.
b) Either party's liability for damages shall be limited to the amounts
actually paid by the other party.

Any claim (including, without limitation, claims for
infringement of third party intellectual property,
publicity, or privacy rights) arising from the e-centives
Content, including, without limitation, e-centives'
trademarks, but excluding claims based upon the Excite

Any claims (including, without limitation, claims for

of or based upon e-centives' services and/or any other

Content or any other materials provided by e-centives in the form

ambiguities: Clause 20 expressly excludes the indemnity claims in Sections 19(a)(iii)(2), 19(a)(iii)(3), 19(b)(iii)(2), and 19(b)(iii)(3), so those indemnity exposures may sit outside the stated liability cap.

Clause 20.b caps liability by "the amounts actually paid by the other party," not by a fixed stated figure; because payments are partly redacted and future-dependent, the cap cannot be reduced to a single monetary amount from this text.

fields.value: Multiple exclusivity and restrictive covenants: Excite@Home must not offer substantially similar branded/co-branded services during the term; each party is restricted from serving ads for the other's Named Competitors on the Co-Branded Application; both parties have User Data transfer restrictions; e-centives has no-solicitation/contact restrictions; certain Excite@Home advertiser offers are exclusive for 30 days; and the first post-termination email is exclusive to e-centives in certain termination scenarios.

quotes.text:
Excite@Home shall not offer any Excite-branded or Excite-co-branded
service during the Term of this Agreement that is substantially similar
in functionally to the Co-Branded Application.

Excite@Home will not serve advertising on the Co-Branded Application for
any "Application Provider Named Competitor," as specified in EXHIBIT E.

Application Provider will not serve advertising on the Co-Branded
Application for any "Excite@Home Named Competitor," as specified in
EXHIBIT E.

In no event may either party sell, disclose, transfer, rent, or
license Payment-Eligible User Data to the other party's Named
Competitors as listed in EXHIBIT E.

Application Provider will not solicit any Excite@Home Member on
behalf of any Excite@Home Named Competitor during the Term of this
Agreement or thereafter.

e-centives may not extend exclusive offers developed for Excite@Home
by its advertisers to non-Excite@Home users of the e-centives service
for a period of 30 days following the day on which the offer is first
made available through Excite@Home.

The first email will be exclusive to e-centives (i.e., it will
not mention similar services from Excite@Home or other third
parties) and will alert Program Members of the continuation of
the e-centives service directly from e-centives.

In the event that the Agreement is terminated pursuant to Section
16.a.v. due to e-centives' acquisition by an Excite@Home Named
Competitor, or by an entity controlling or controlled by an
Excite@Home Named Competitor, e-centives or its assigns or designates
may not contact any Users for whom User Data has been provided
pursuant to this Agreement, excluding those that have opted out in
accordance with Section 5(a) of Exhibit D.

ambiguities: Several restrictions run only during the Term, and Clause 15 does not state the Launch Date needed to calculate the Term end date.
The Named Competitor and Data Restricted company lists may be updated under clauses 4(d), 4(e), and 6(b)(iii), so the restricted counterparties may change over time.
The 30-day exclusivity in clause 9(d) runs separately for each offer from the day that offer is first made available through Excite@Home, which is not dated in the document.
The post-termination exclusivity and contact restrictions in clause 17 apply only after specified termination scenarios.
